lineItems.description: Attendance Management System with Device & 2-Year Subscription
lineItems.details: Complete attendance solution for 20 users including: biometric/RFID device setup and configuration, network integration, employee enrollment, system training, and 2 years of cloud-based attendance platform subscription. Covers real-time attendance tracking, automated reporting, leave management, mobile app access, and 24/7 technical support.

installments.details: Complete package includes device setup, configuration, and 24 months of cloud platform subscription
Optional annual renewal to continue service beyond the initial 2-year period

notes.terms: This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date above. Prices do not include VAT where applicable.
notes.technicalRequirements: Internet connectivity (minimum 2 Mbps), secure network for device integration
notes.implementation: Typical implementation and go-live within 2-3 weeks of contract signing
notes.additionalServices: Additional users beyond 20 can be added at 4 OMR per user per year. Custom device integrations available upon request.
